jordan: quick q — when streaming a function/tool call that arrives across multiple delta events, what's the canonical signal we expect clients to use to know the call is finished? do we rely on a boolean in the tool_call object, an explicit 'tool_call_end' event, or the old 'role:tool' final message? cc @ines
ines: short answer: we emit a tool_call object in deltas and mark completion explicitly. current spec/pr uses a `complete: true` flag + stable `id` for reassembly. there's also an explicit event flavor for systems that prefer events: {event: \"tool_call_end\", id: \"...\"}. see PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345
sam: edge case: what happens if the client reconnects mid-stream and only sees the first few deltas? will they be able to reassemble? runtime currently writes partials keyed by id so a resumed session can fetch the rest — but that's on the runtime side not the client. should we document `continuation: true` when a delta is partial?
alex-sdk: agreed with sam — SDK will need a default buffer-until-complete behavior and an opt-in for partial-delivery. proposed delta shape we discussed in the PR: 
```
// delta 1
{"delta": {"tool_call": {"id":"abc123", "name":"search", "args":"{\"q\":\"foo\"}", "continuation": true}}}
// delta 2 (final)
{"delta": {"tool_call": {"id":"abc123", "args":"...rest...", "complete": true}}}
```
ben-sec: security note: for private deployments we must avoid logging full `args` in plaintext. runtime should offer redaction hooks and the PR must add a security checklist + tests. also please keep arg ordering deterministic — some downstream tools rely on stable ordering for signature checks.
ci-bot: CI: integration tests for PR #2345 passed on staging. canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-19 09:00 PT :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jordan: ok — two follow-ups: 1) add a tiny compatibility section for older clients that expect a terminal `role: \"tool\"` message (plan: runtime emits both for one release cycle), and 2) alex-sdk can you add a short example to the SDK docs showing how to handle partial vs final tool_call deltas? i'll open the compatibility PR after lunch.
nines: sounds good. ping @ben-sec and @alex-sdk when you open the PR so we can review the checklist. :thumbsup:
alex-sdk: will add docs example and a small unit test for buffering behavior. thanks for the heads-up.
jordan: thanks all — will file the PR and tag reviewers.
